basis: The chart title explicitly states 'Stable Revenue of Company C from Q1 to Q4'. The O/B check for record r2 confirms this title is supported and that the workflow treats such a description as requiring the stability response. The visual data (Q1≈1100, Q2≈1380, Q3≈1380, Q4≈1620) shows an overall increase, but the title is the authoritative source for routing, and no explicit policy overrides it.
